parrafo_1.es: Baumgardners Handy Services es el negocio de Jordan en Gainesville. El equipo hace reparaciones eléctricas, instala abanicos y luminarias, resuelve plomería (desde inodoros hasta fugas) y se encarga de decks, pisos y reparaciones generales del hogar.
parrafo_1.en: Baumgardners Handy Services is Jordan's business in Gainesville. The team handles electrical repairs, installs fans and light fixtures, takes care of plumbing (from toilets to leaks) and handles decks, flooring and general home repairs.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas repiten lo mismo: contestan el teléfono cuando nadie más lo hace, llegan al día siguiente y dejan el trabajo terminado y limpio. De más de 10 empresas contactadas, Jordan fue el único que respondió.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews keep saying the same thing: they pick up the phone when nobody else does, show up the next day and leave the job finished and clean. Out of more than 10 companies contacted, Jordan was the only one who answered.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesitas: un cable, una fuga, un abanico o una reparación general. Contestamos el teléfono, sin intermediarios.
texto.en: Tell us what you need: wiring, a leak, a fan install or a general repair. We answer the phone directly, no middlemen.

texto.es: Vamos a la propiedad, revisamos el trabajo y te damos un precio claro antes de empezar.
texto.en: We visit the property, look at the job and give you a clear price before starting.

texto.es: Reparación, instalación o remodelación terminada con cuidado, tal como lo describen nuestros clientes.
texto.en: Repair, install or remodel finished with care, exactly the way our clients describe it.

texto.es: Dejamos el lugar limpio y revisamos el resultado contigo antes de irnos.
texto.en: We leave the place clean and walk the result through with you before we leave.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el alcance. Llámanos y te damos el precio sin compromiso.

items.quote: Jordan did an amazing job installing fans and light fixtures in my new house. He was very courteous and professional. I would definitely recommend him and use his service again
Jordan did a fabulous and professional job managing some electrical repairs. He was handling a long-distance job and kept me appraised at each step of the process. Very comfortable working with him.

I called Jordan about some work I needed to be done. He told me he would come to our home the next day and he was here just like he said. His company is the most reliable service I have found in town. He performed the work, cleaned up, was very professional and his rates were reasonable. Thank you Jordan for the great job.
